To
The Principal,
Main PW Govt Exam Centre,
Patna.
Subject: Request for a Solution to the Smart Board Issue During Power Cut
Dear Sir,
I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention a significant issue that we, the students of Hall No. 5, are facing. During our classes, when the power supply is interrupted and the lights go off, the smart board in the classroom also turns off, causing a disruption in our studies.
As you are aware, the smart board plays a crucial role in our learning process, and any interruption in its function significantly hampers our ability to continue with the lesson smoothly. This has been affecting our preparation, especially considering the importance of our ongoing exams.
I kindly request you to consider implementing a solution to ensure that the smart board remains operational even during power cuts. One potential solution could be installing an uninterrupted power supply (UPS) system that would keep the smart board running even in the event of a power outage. This would allow us to continue with our lessons without any interruption.
I would be grateful if you could look into this matter at the earliest and provide a feasible solution. Your prompt attention to this issue would greatly enhance our learning experience.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
Yours sincerely,
